# Losing Weight RX - Weight Wellness Quiz

> A short eligibility quiz to help adults explore whether a doctor-supervised weight wellness program could be a fit.

## About

Losing Weight RX is an educational resource that helps people connect with independent, licensed healthcare providers offering doctor-supervised weight wellness programs. We are not a medical provider, pharmacy, or clinic.

This quiz is hosted at https://medquiz.viralfavorite.com/ and takes approximately 60 seconds to complete.

## What This Quiz Does

- Asks 5 quick questions about age, goals, history, body metrics, and readiness
- Segments users by intent level (high, moderate, exploratory)
- Connects qualified users to a licensed provider assessment via affiliate partnership
- Captures email for personalized follow-up

## What This Quiz Does NOT Do

- Provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment
- Guarantee eligibility for any program
- Prescribe medications or recommend specific drugs
- Store or process protected health information (PHI)

## Quiz Questions

1. Age confirmation (18+ required)
2. Primary wellness goal
3. Prior weight wellness program experience
4. Height and weight (optional, skippable)
5. Readiness to start a program

## Compliance

- No drug, brand, or molecule names are used (e.g., no Ozempic, Wegovy, semaglutide)
- All advertising disclosures for Google Ads and Meta/Facebook are included
- FTC affiliate compensation disclosure is present
- CAN-SPAM compliant email consent
- Adults 18+ only
